title: Absolute Stability of Nonlinear Negative Imaginary Systems with Application to Potential Energy Shaping
summary: This paper establishes absolute stability conditions for nonlinear negative imaginary (NI) systems interconnected with static nonlinear feedback. We first show that the NI property is preserved when the feedback nonlinearity can be expressed as the gradient of a continuously differentiable function, and the composite storage of the resulting system remains positive definite. This condition provides a direct connection between nonlinear static feedback and storage-function shaping along the measured output channels.
